clube.nome: Rotary Club of Porto União – União da Vitória
clube.descricaoCurta: Uniting Porto União (SC) and União da Vitória (PR) since 1949 through service, leadership and social transformation.
clube.sobre: Founded in 1949, the Rotary Club of Porto União – União da Vitória brings together leaders and volunteers from both banks of the Iguaçu River — Santa Catarina and Paraná — around a single purpose: to serve. For more than seven decades, the club has carried out projects in social impact, health, education and the environment, integrated with District 4740 and the worldwide Rotary International network.
clube.historia: On September 27, 1949, in one of the halls of the Cruz Hotel, on Praça Hercílio Luz in Porto União, the Rotary Club of Porto União – União da Vitória was officially chartered, under the presidency of fellow Rotarian José Moura Júnior and with district governor Arnaldo Suarez Cuneo in attendance. At that session, 19 Rotarians became the club's founding members, born with a clear purpose: to unite both banks of the Iguaçu River — Porto União (SC) and União da Vitória (PR) — around the ideal of service. That same night, the first board was elected, with Euclides Taborda Ribas as the first elected president. More than seven decades later, that same commitment endures.
